newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rapid forex moves undesirable - Japan MOF's Kuroda.
newsitem.headline: Rapid forex moves undesirable - Japan MOF's Kuroda.

text.p: Rapid movements in the foreign exchange market are undesirable, Haruhiko Kuroda, director-general of the Finance Ministry's international finance bureau, told reporters on Wednesday.
Asked about the speed of the dollar's recent rise against the yen, Kuroda said: "I can't comment on specific levels, but rapid movements are undesirable."
He added that currencies should move in a stable manner that reflects economic fundamentals.
Kuroda spoke with reporters after giving a speech to a meeting of the Forex Club. The meeting was closed to the press.
